Kandev maner katha, prem ki shudhu vyatha?
Uttar ajo mele na
Mele na, mele na, mele na
Bode na se, bode na

E buke et prem, taar chokhe ghrina
Cha na shunate se e buker kanna
Aami chokher bali, kii kare take bali
E buke kii vedna?

Prithivi ekadiqu, ekadiqu aami
Aaj amar rakte mishe geso tumi
Naiba halo dekha, dekhbo eka eka
Swapne nei simana
